reuse.why: The change reuses budget writes, sheet access, batching and undo wrappers, but shares only fragments of category eligibility.

duplication.why: Five actions repeat the category query, and six independently assemble the same income, visibility, template and fixed-group exclusions.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation remain in server budget modules, with method registration in the existing application layer.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested month-wide actions, supporting template selection, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Future eligibility changes require coordinated edits across several queries and loops despite the shared template and fixed-group helpers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The original tree has no shared month-wide eligibility abstraction, and the change continues using existing budget mutation and undo abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: In actions.ts, copyPreviousMonth expresses hidden-category eligibility through JavaScript guards while the other month-wide actions express the same policy through SQL predicates.

abstraction_drift.where: goal-template.ts adds excludedGroupIds to getCategories; the existing tree has no shared month-wide eligibility helper to bypass.
